Hero_Desc_Veroo:
A flaw phantom.
Veroo is famous for being a phantom who badmouths others.
She has a habit of picking out the flaws of others, regardless of the situation.
Album_Hate_Veroo: Having her own faults pointed out before she can criticize someone else
Album_Wish_Veroo: To gain eyes sharp enough to spot another's faults instantly
Album_Veroo7: Once, I attempted to reconcile Veroo with a ghost angered by her insults. Yet the moment Veroo opened her mouth to apologize, she discovered another flaw and began criticizing the ghost again. The Order descended into chaos that day.
LoveHero_Veroo:
Riddled with weaknesses,
where do you think you're going?
LoveHeroCancel_Veroo:
I've collected
plenty of your weakness.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Hate1: She seems displeased that its faint flavor leaves her with nothing worthwhile to criticize.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Hate2: She condemned it as food that concealed a major defect beneath a decorated exterior. Apparently, a flaw visible from the beginning would be preferable.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like1: She found its uncontrolled wobbling amusingly foolish. Then she began swaying her own body in exactly the same way... She would become angry if I said they resembled each other, right?
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like2: She liked the thought that eating one piece at a time while watching others make mistakes and expose weaknesses would be delicious. Her reasoning is rather strange.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like3: The warm broth seems to please her. She appeared to be tasting it little by little, but before long the entire bowl was empty.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like4: At first, the appearance fooled her, and she gleefully mocked me for serving something inedible. Once she learned it was real food, she silently devoted herself to eating.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like5: She seems to enjoy the tart, exhilarating flavor. When she tried to take a handful of powder secretly, I agreed to wrap some separately.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like6: She pointed out that the different colors surely meant they had been made incorrectly, so I placed them in her mouth one by one. They must have tasted good, because she made no further complaint.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like7: She finished them quickly, apparently finding the flavor agreeable. I had to work hard to stop her from repeatedly tossing the Almond Rochers around midway through.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like8: She seems to have discovered the pleasure of pouring a little at a time into her mouth. She ate with such concentration that she did not notice anyone speaking beside her.
Food_ChefNote_Veroo_Like9: No matter how long she glared, she apparently could find no particular flaw in the dish. In the end, she quietly ate every candy.
Gacha_Result_Line1_Veroo: You're a weak one, aren't you?
Gacha_Result_Line2_Veroo: Earplugs are required when meeting me
Veroo_Spawn2: This will be over in a second.
Veroo_Victory2: Got something new to tease about.
Veroo_Defeat1: The opponent was just too good...
Veroo_Defeat2: Go ahead... Just try blaming me for this!
Veroo_Affinity1_2: Want me to cover your weaknesses?
Veroo_Affinity1_3: Go on, show me an opening.
Veroo_Affinity3: May I tease you a little more harshly than usual?
Veroo_Affinity4: For some reason, you have a face that makes me want to tease you.
Veroo_Affinity5: You want me to stop teasing you? No. I will do as I please~!
Veroo_Affinity7: I shall torment you a little more sweetly~
Veroo_Die2: I think I did good, you know?
Veroo_LevelUp: I think I've gotten strong enough.
Veroo_HeroUpgrade: I'm going to be a phantom full of talents!
Veroo_Touch2_1: Hmm... this isn't so bad, actually...
Veroo_Touch1_2: You do this to others, too?
Veroo_Touch2: W-What's this all of a sudden?!
Veroo_Touch2_2: You do this to others, too?
Veroo_SPSkill1: Can you take all of these?
Veroo_SPSkill1-01: Can you take all of these?
Veroo_Birthday: Your birthday? Fine, I will congratulate you.
Veroo_Lobby: No matter how I look at it, nobody around here is perfect.
LoveLetter_Veroo:
Master, are you not afraid to live while displaying so many weaknesses?

How long do you imagine the Apostles will continue protecting you? Prepare yourself. The day I catch you properly, you will surrender every pudding in the Order's banquet hall.

As an additional penalty for losing to me, you will join Sari beside me and take responsibility for every reaction. Understood?
LoveCall_Veroo:
Master~! What are you doing? Busy? Well, even if you are, that is none of my concern.
I was growing bored. I can visit your room immediately, right? I do not think I will feel satisfied until I torment you thoroughly.
You had better not say no~ Do you know how many weaknesses of yours I have collected while observing you? Refuse, and I will spread every one of them! Heeheehee! Perhaps that would be even more fun~?

...What? What are you talking about?! I did not ask to play together. I am going to make fun of you! Wh-Why would I play with someone like you?!
Hmph! Judging by the way you speak, this will not do. I must come immediately. I have not teased you properly lately, and now you have forgotten your place, have you?
Wait just a moment~ I will be there to torment you immediately!
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_001: Hmm... I am bored. Is there nothing fun to do, Master?
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_002: I am bored too. Play with me!
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_003: Ugh. Do not cling to me suddenly, Master! I take back what I said about being bored!
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_004: If you are bored, come help me wash the dishes.
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_005: What? No. I came here as a guest!
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_006: Shaydi is outside. Go play with her.
Affinity_Veroo_EP01_007: Uh... L-Lady Shaydi is a little... difficult for me to play with...
Affinity_Veroo_EP02_001: What is this? Dust has gathered here. My~ The Banquet Hall has quite a few flaws~
Affinity_Veroo_EP02_002: That will not do. I should close and clean first.
Affinity_Veroo_EP02_003: Huh? R-right now? Wait! I have not finished eating!
Affinity_Veroo_EP02_005: Hmm...? For me? Do you expect me to clean? Hey, people should fix their own flaws!
Affinity_Veroo_EP02_006: The dust is part of the interior design.
Affinity_Veroo_EP02_007: Oh, you will conceal your flaws that way? Who would fall for that? Clean it up at once~!
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_001: Those foolish ghosts. Why do they avoid me whenever I approach?
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_002: I think I know the reason.
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_003: Hmm? What is it?! Tch, why make me curious and then refuse to tell me?!
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_004: Try treating the ghosts more kindly.
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_005: Kindly? I have never been unkind to the other ghosts.
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_006: Ahem, would you keep some distance from me too?
Affinity_Veroo_EP03_007: What? Why are you backing away too, Master?! Foolish Master!
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_001: Traveling all the way here from the Ghost Swamp is too far. Can you build another one closer by?
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_002: If you give me a little more time and budget...
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_003: Huh? That is for you to arrange, Master. You are the Master, yet you cannot decide even that?
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_004: Fine. Let us build another and name it Veroo's Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_005: Oh, you will give it my name? Hmm... That sounds impressive! I like it!
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_006: Perhaps I could ask Shoupan to deliver the food...
Affinity_Veroo_EP04_007: You mean that restless Sprite? Ugh, I doubt the dishes would retain their proper shape.
Affinity_Veroo_EP05_001: Hmm. I cannot find anything to criticize today. Master, make some sort of mistake!
Affinity_Veroo_EP05_003: Eek, why did you truly spill the water?! You spilled it, so wipe it all up yourself.
Affinity_Veroo_EP05_004: Forgive me for being too perfect to make mistakes.
Affinity_Veroo_EP05_005: Ugh... That makes me angry. Fine, I shall follow you everywhere and watch until you make a mistake!
Affinity_Veroo_EP05_006: Do you never make mistakes, Veroo?
Affinity_Veroo_EP05_007: Of course I sometimes make mistakes. But I shall never allow you to see one, Master! Hehe.
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_001: Those lower-ranking Elementals ran away sniffling after I said only a few words. What did I ever do to them?
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_002: ...You are not truly asking because you do not know, are you?
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_003: Hmm, who knows? Perhaps I know... and perhaps I do not. Hee hee!
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_004: Sylla will scold you for that.
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_005: Ugh. That boss Elemental is rather difficult to face. Perhaps I should visit someone other than Elementals for a while.
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_006: Apologize the next time you meet them.
Affinity_Veroo_EP06_007: Aha, will apologizing bring them back? Then I can make them cry and chase them away again. Hee hee!
Affinity_Veroo_EP07_001: Yawn~ The service here is rather poor. I should deduct some stars!
Affinity_Veroo_EP07_003: Hehe, what do you mean, no? If you do not want to lose stars, treat me better!
Affinity_Veroo_EP07_004: I should report a guest who uses ratings as a threat.
Affinity_Veroo_EP07_005: Hmm? Is being reported bad? Huh, I deducted plenty of stars around the Elf town.
Affinity_Veroo_EP07_006: What sort of treatment do you want?
Affinity_Veroo_EP07_007: Oh, that is for you to handle well, Master. Let us see whether you can satisfy me!
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_001: Do you not become bored doing nothing but cooking here, Master? What do you usually do?
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_002: I remain here for the pleasure of conversations like this with all of you.
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_003: Huh, what is this? Are you saying that to earn points? Hmm? You mean it sincerely?
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_004: Resting without doing anything is best.
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_005: Really? You are lazy, Master~ Well, sometimes I also want to do nothing but rest.
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_006: I am busy working. The Master has many duties.
Affinity_Veroo_EP08_007: Hmm~? Yet whenever I see you here, you do nothing but chat with other people!
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_001: Sari can be terribly frustrating, and Maison is no fun at all. Honestly!
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_002: You should not speak badly of your friends.
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_003: Speak badly? I merely say what I think. Both of them truly are like that.
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_004: I think everyone may have flaws.
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_005: Well, that is true! You have a great many flaws too, Master. Hehe, shall I name a few?
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_006: I think you can be frustrating and dull sometimes too, Veroo.
Affinity_Veroo_EP09_007: Wh-what?! I have plenty of other strengths, so flaws of that size do not matter!
Affinity_Veroo_EP10_001: Hmm... I want dessert today too. Of course, if I dislike it, I shall criticize it mercilessly!
Affinity_Veroo_EP10_003: Oh, why ask that?! I am allowed to want more food. What a tactless question!
Affinity_Veroo_EP10_005: H-hmm? Uh... I-I withdraw my last remark, so may I have dessert first?
Affinity_Veroo_EP10_006: Then I shall keep making desserts until you are satisfied.
Affinity_Veroo_EP10_007: ...Huh? Does that mean I must keep eating as long as I remain dissatisfied?
Affinity_Veroo_EP11_001: You look busy. Why not rest? At this rate you will add something strange and ruin the food.
Affinity_Veroo_EP11_003: ...What? Me? I am merely worried that the food will be ruined.
Affinity_Veroo_EP11_004: I can add strange ingredients and still make something delicious.
Affinity_Veroo_EP11_005: ...Truly? You are not saying that while planning to make a complete mess and serve it to me, are you?
Affinity_Veroo_EP11_006: Oops. I made this incorrectly by mistake. Would you like to try it?
Affinity_Veroo_EP11_007: Hmph. No. Why should I eat your mistake? Make it again and bring it to me!
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_001: Master, do I truly speak that harshly? What do you think?
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_002: Hmm... Well, you do not exactly speak kindly.
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_003: What sort of vague answer is that? You cannot bring yourself to say I speak well?
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_004: I think it is part of your individuality, Veroo.
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_005: Uh... Truly? No, that simply was not the answer I expected. Hmm... So that is how you see it?
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_006: You can improve little by little.
Affinity_Veroo_EP12_007: Tch. That still means you think it is bad, does it not? Well, fine!
Affinity_Veroo_EP13_001: The others say my clothes are too dark to see at night. Is there some solution?
Affinity_Veroo_EP13_003: Glow-in-the-dark... Hmm... That does not sound bad. It may be more fun than I expected! Hehe.
Affinity_Veroo_EP13_004: Borrow a pumpkin lantern from Speaki and carry it.
Affinity_Veroo_EP13_005: Do you think that pumpkin ghost lends her pumpkins freely? Not a chance.
Affinity_Veroo_EP13_006: How about installing many streetlamps in the Ghost Swamp?
Affinity_Veroo_EP13_007: Uh... If we can erect them properly in the swamp, it might work. Are you serious?
Affinity_Veroo_EP14_001: Even the Ghost Swamp becomes dull sometimes. The ghosts need to invent something more entertaining!
Affinity_Veroo_EP14_003: You mean those things the Beastfolk carry and sometimes play? They look rather complicated to me.
Affinity_Veroo_EP14_004: How about beautifying the environment around the Ghost Swamp?
Affinity_Veroo_EP14_005: Huh? Does that not simply mean cleaning? I need an entertaining activity, not that!
Affinity_Veroo_EP14_006: Just do not visit the Banquet Hall whenever you become bored.
Affinity_Veroo_EP14_007: Hee hee, saying that makes me want to visit. Shall I bring all the other ghosts for a group visit? What do you think?
Affinity_Veroo_EP15_001: Master! What kind of ghost frightens you most? I am curious!
Affinity_Veroo_EP15_003: What? That is unfair. Tell only me! I am terribly curious.
Affinity_Veroo_EP15_005: Hmph. What nonsense. Shall we put that to the test?
Affinity_Veroo_EP15_007: Huh? Truly? Hehehe. So that is how you thought of me, Master?
Affinity_Veroo_EP16_001: Be honest, Master. There must be people you dislike. Tell only me! I will not tell anyone else.
Affinity_Veroo_EP16_003: Oh? Not that there are none, but that you cannot say? So there is someone after all. Understood. Hehe!
Affinity_Veroo_EP16_005: Hmm? I am the only one here... You cannot mean me, can you...? Truly? You truly do?
Affinity_Veroo_EP16_007: Oh~ Really? Are you telling the truth? Hmm... You are impressive, Master.
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_001: Is it not difficult to cook and serve all of this constantly? Why do you do it?
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_002: Because I want to make something delicious for everyone with my own hands.
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_003: Hmm. Your cooking certainly is delicious! Everyone comes here to eat it.
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_004: Because that is how the Order can become stronger.
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_005: Hmm? Is it? What does cooking have to do with becoming stronger...?
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_006: True. Shall I simply close the business tomorrow?
Affinity_Veroo_EP17_007: Huh? What is this sudden decision? You are not upset because of what I said, are you?
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_001: Hmm, a sweet aroma. Rather pleasant.
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_002: How unusual to hear you offer praise.
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_003: I do not complain about everything! I give praise when praise is due.
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_004: Do you like sweet things too?
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_005: Well, it is simply a difference in impression. If something is perfectly sweet without flaws, I think it is good!
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_006: There is no share for you.
Affinity_Veroo_EP18_007: Hmph, I did not ask for any! I never intended to take a share in the first place!
Affinity_Veroo_EP19_003: I do not know. I simply dislike everything. Still, seeing you and talking together makes it somewhat better.
Affinity_Veroo_EP19_004: Something delicious will cheer you up quickly.
Affinity_Veroo_EP19_005: I cannot merely eat every time I feel bad. I must remove the flaw causing the problem.
Affinity_Veroo_EP19_006: If you cannot put your heart into it... shall you put it down? Pfft!
Affinity_Veroo_EP19_007: What, are you imitating Rim now? Ugh, do not pick up strange habits.
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_001: They say your ears itch when someone speaks badly about you. Shall we experiment?
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_002: Very well. Go and stand over there.
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_003: Hmm? What, I play the one who hears the insults? That is rather different from what I imagined...
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_004: Do you simply want to speak badly of me?
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_005: Ah, you noticed? Oh well. But you are curious whether it is true too! Let us try once.
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_006: Do you still believe tales like that?
Affinity_Veroo_EP20_007: Why not? It may be true. If someone says a tremendous amount of bad things, perhaps your ears truly will itch... Hee hee!
